Featured · Open source

MetalAtom — Gas Atomizer Simulator (EIGA)

Finds the settings where a thin melt thread survives into the nozzle bore.

Built from five years of running an EIGA atomizer: the melt would lump up and clog the nozzle instead of forming a clean thread. MetalAtom finds the settings — power, feed rate, gas pressure, fall distance — where a thin melt thread survives into the nozzle bore. Alloys Ti-6Al-4V, 316L, 17-4PH, Inconel 718; gases Ar, N₂, He.

THE CORE IDEA
  • Melt only the rod surface, so it flows down as a film
  • Film → thin thread → into the nozzle bore, not blobs
  • Models heating, film flow, thread breakup & powder size
